name: Analyze Protein Colocalization
description: Analyze colocalization between two fluorescently labeled proteins in microscopy images.
detailed_description: Analyze colocalization between two fluorescently labeled proteins in microscopy images.
when_to_use: When you need analyze protein colocalization analysis

parameters.channel1_path: [Required] Path to the first channel image file (fluorescent protein 1) (str)
parameters.channel2_path: [Required] Path to the second channel image file (fluorescent protein 2) (str)
parameters.threshold_method: [Optional] Method for thresholding images ('otsu', 'li', or 'yen') (default: otsu)
